guidetextdraw_609773._value: Additional information is needed to explain your 2020 federal income tax filing status. Before we can determine financial need, we need verification from the Internal Revenue   Service (IRS) that you (and your spouse) did not file a Federal Income Tax Return for 2020.   Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw_609773.name: textdraw_6097737761646304849565_copy_1

guidetextdraw_1808906643._value: Contact the IRS to complete IRS Form 4506T (http://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f4506t.pdf).
guidetextdraw_1808906643.name: textdraw_18089066431651832753306

guidetextdraw_709031248._value: Check item 7 on the form to request Verification of Non-filing Status
guidetextdraw_709031248.name: textdraw_7090312481660881440252

guidetextdraw_1579008778._value: Submit received IRS response to the Office of Financial Aid for review by attaching a copy  to this form.
guidetextdraw_1579008778.name: textdraw_15790087781660881464335

guidetextdraw._value:
Please Note:

  • Attachment does not support following special characters / \\ : * ? & { } ; [ ]
  • Only PDF files are allowed!
  • At least one supporting document is required.
